# 可能与必然被吸入 / Possibly and necessarily drawn

## 主张 Claim

区域外的配置可能被吸入区域（PossiblyDrawnInto），指从它出发的某个路径进入区域；必然被吸入（NecessarilyDrawnInto），指从它开始的每个运行都进入；被吸入（PossiblyDrawn、NecessarilyDrawn），指某个过程从不离开的区域（Frame.Invariant）如此吸入它。在确定的律下两者都是 P67 的（law_possibly_iff、law_necessarily_iff、law_drawn_iff）。返回的配置有一个从不失去它的运行，绕其路径永远回到它（Branching.Returns.run，构造性地）。所以每个过程必然吸入的恰是不返回者（necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns，Law.drawn_iff_not_returns 的实例）：必然被吸入者从不返回（NecessarilyDrawnInto.not_returns），不返回者在第一步必然被吸入它前方之处（necessarilyDrawnInto_ahead）。可能被吸入就是在某一路径中失去自身（possiblyDrawn_iff），沿该路径被锁定（PossiblyDrawnInto.never_back）；可能被吸入者可以在另一路径中返回：OneWay 的 false 可能而非必然被吸入 {true}，并且返回（OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily）。在确定的过程下，动作决定运行是否被吸入（Determined.moves_decide）。每个过程下未来变窄：n 步后可得者是过程从不离开的区域（reachable_invariant），失去的可能必然被吸入它（lost_necessarily_drawn）；在有限多配置中每个运行都进入返回者（Run.enters_returning），在有限多配置中，运行开始处的配置必然被吸入与不合并矛盾（NecessarilyDrawn.not_lossless，结论为 ¬ Lossless P，不给出 Merges 的见证）。对过程不成立的：返回者不是过程从不离开的区域（Transit.returning_not_invariant）；合并不必吸入两者之一（OneWay.merge_keeps）。在 Capture 中，规则保持自身时，具有给定规则的配置是律从不离开的区域（Law.rule_absorbing），下一配置也只依赖规则时，规则所持的配置固定（Law.held_absorbing），扰动的状态在第一步被吸入它（Law.perturbation_drawnInto）；Captured 中的实例（Captured.rule_region_absorbing、Captured.held_absorbing、Captured.state_perturbation_drawn、Captured.rule_perturbation_drawn）。不加前提。 / A configuration outside a region is possibly drawn into it (PossiblyDrawnInto) where some course from it enters it, and necessarily drawn (NecessarilyDrawnInto) where every run from it does; drawn (PossiblyDrawn, NecessarilyDrawn) where some region the process never leaves (Frame.Invariant) so draws it. Under a determined law both are P67's (law_possibly_iff, law_necessarily_iff, law_drawn_iff). A configuration that returns has a run that never loses it, going round its course back to it forever (Branching.Returns.run, constructively). So every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return (necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns, the instance of Law.drawn_iff_not_returns): what is necessarily drawn never returns (NecessarilyDrawnInto.not_returns), and what does not return is necessarily drawn into what lies ahead of it at the first step (necessarilyDrawnInto_ahead). Possibly drawn is losing oneself on some course (possiblyDrawn_iff), locked in along that course (PossiblyDrawnInto.never_back); a configuration possibly drawn may return on another course: OneWay's false is possibly but not necessarily drawn into {true}, and returns (OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily). Under a determined process the moves decide whether a run is drawn in (Determined.moves_decide). Under every process the future narrows: what can be had n steps on is a region the process never leaves (reachable_invariant), and a lost possibility is necessarily drawn into it (lost_necessarily_drawn); within finitely many configurations every run enters what returns (Run.enters_returning), and within finitely many configurations a necessarily drawn starting configuration of a given run contradicts losslessness (NecessarilyDrawn.not_lossless, concluding ¬ Lossless P rather than supplying a witness of Merges). What fails for processes: what returns is not a region the process never leaves (Transit.returning_not_invariant); a merge need draw neither of the two (OneWay.merge_keeps). In Capture, where the rule keeps itself, the configurations with a given rule are a region the law never leaves (Law.rule_absorbing); where the next configuration also depends on the rule alone, the configuration the rule holds is fixed (Law.held_absorbing), and a perturbed state is drawn into it at the first step (Law.perturbation_drawnInto); the instances in Captured (Captured.rule_region_absorbing, Captured.held_absorbing, Captured.state_perturbation_drawn, Captured.rule_perturbation_drawn). No premise.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 没有运行开始的配置（死路）空洞地必然被吸入每个不含它的区域，因为核心的运行不终止。 / A configuration from which no run begins (a dead end) is necessarily drawn into every region not containing it, vacuously, as the core's runs are unending.

P81（工作板），同上；P67 的吸引对不确定的过程。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：可能与必然被吸入恰在路径开放处分开：一个配置可以在一个路径中被吸入而在另一个中回来；每个路径都吸入的是不返回者，某个路径吸入的是能失去自身者。Capture 读作吸引：只改革状态被吸回规则所持之处，吸引子只随规则移动。见整合文档 §99。 / P81 (work board), as above; P67's attraction for processes that are not determined. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): possibly and necessarily drawn come apart exactly where the course is open: a configuration can be drawn in on one course and come back on another; what every course draws in is what does not return, what some course draws in is what can lose itself. Capture read as attraction: perturbation of the state alone is drawn back into what the rule holds, and the attractor moves only with the rule. See the integration document §99.
